about: S-coach-plans - the frame data of coach-plans-1 and the undrawn states of Edzéstervek (/coach/plans, PLAN 4.1 rule 7). Every fixture is a list of edits over the recording of GET /api/v1/plans, or a stubbed answer (R26). Every state is replay. Accounts: C = coach@ (frame 1 and every state), R = demo.coach.szilagyi.reka@ (frame 2, empty library), M = user@ (forbidden). Nothing is written live by this package.

coach-plans-1.why: The recording of C lists 11 plans, three of them the PULSE sandbox rows (_subcheck.dataNotDrawn.sandboxVisible); the frame draws 6. The edits keep six recorded rows in the recorded order, give them the drawn names, statuses, day counts and client names, and remove the other five. The frame's third client plan is ended (Lezárva); no recording holds an ended plan, so pulse-fixture-check refuses that value and the row stays active here (Aktív 5 / Piszkozat 1 instead of Aktív 4 / Piszkozat 1 / Lezárva 1). The one extra edit { "pointer": "/plans/3/status", "value": "ended" } is request R-S-coach-plans-01; a capture with it is .pulse/pairs/S-coach-plans/coach-plans-1.with-ended-edit.pair.png. Verdict matched-fixture with that one difference.
